items.title: Sales Director Argentina
items.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales to lead and grow our commercial strategy at Futbol Sites . This is a leadership position for a senior professional with a strong network and proven track record in digital media advertising . The ideal candidate combines deep market knowledge with strong commercial expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to build long-term relationships with advertisers, agencies, brands, and strategic partners. Based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for leading your team to drive revenue growth across the market, developing new business opportunities, strengthening key client relationships, and leading a high-performing sales team. You will play a key role in positioning Futbol Sites as a leading sports media partner and identifying new opportunities across the evolving digital advertising ecosystem. What You'll Do Commercial Leadership & Strategy Instill a partnership-first mindset across the team, coaching reps to prioritize long-term relationship depth and strategic account growth over transactional, campaign-by-campaign selling. Define and execute the commercial strategy for the market, aligned with Futbol Sites' regional and global objectives. Identify new revenue opportunities across digital media, sports, football, branded content, programmatic, sponsorships, and other relevant commercial solutions. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics, advertiser needs, agency structures, competitors, and emerging digital media trends. Contribute to the evolution of Futbol Sites' commercial offering and go-to-market strategy. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the commercial team, setting clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations. Build a high-performing, collaborative, and results-oriented sales culture. Support team members in developing strategic accounts, closing complex opportunities, and expanding existing business. Monitor team performance, pipeline development, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets. Identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities, processes, and commercial best practices across the team. Business Development & Sales Lead the identification and acquisition of new clients, advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners. Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and the sports ecosystem. Personally manage and develop strategic and high-value accounts. Lead major commercial pitches, negotiations, and partnership discussions. Develop innovative and customized commercial proposals that combine Futbol Sites' digital media assets, audience, content, and sports expertise. Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and business growth targets. Market & Industry Leadership Maintain a strong network and active presence within the digital media, advertising, sports, and fútbol industries . Represent Futbol Sites at relevant industry events, meetings, conferences, and client activities. Stay ahead of changes in digital advertising, media consumption, audience behavior, sports marketing, and competitive offerings. Bring market intelligence and new commercial ideas into the organization. Identify opportunities to position Futbol Sites at the forefront of the digital sports media ecosystem. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Marketing, Content, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, Programmatic, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of commercial initiatives. Partner with regional and global stakeholders to share market insights and identify opportunities across Argentina Ensure that client expectations and commercial commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered. What We're Looking For Leadership Experience: Proven experience leading and developing commercial or sales teams, preferably within digital media, advertising, sports, or technology companies. Industry Expertise: Strong background in the digital media and advertising industry , with a solid understanding of the sports and/or fútbol ecosystem. Commercial Track Record: Demonstrated success in developing new business, managing strategic accounts, negotiating complex deals, and consistently achieving revenue targets. Industry Network: Established relationships with advertisers, brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and/or key players within the sports ecosystem. Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of digital advertising, media sales, branded content, sponsorships, audience monetization, and current industry trends. Leadership Skills: Strong ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams while maintaining a high-performance culture. Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate market opportunities into actionable commercial strategies and measurable business results. Communication & Negotiation: Excellent presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and decision-makers. Analytical & Business Acumen: Strong understanding of sales pipelines, forecasting, commercial KPIs, revenue performance, and business planning. Tools: Strong proficiency in PowerPoint/Keynote, Excel, CRM platforms, and other commercial tools. Education: University degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field is preferred. Languages: Advanced English is preferred. Location: Based in Buenos Aires with full-time availability. What Success Looks Like Consistent growth in commercial revenue and market share. A strong and well-developed sales pipeline. Successful acquisition and retention of strategic clients and partners. A high-performing and engaged commercial team. Strong positioning and visibility for Futbol Sites within the digital media and sports industry. Continuous identification of new business opportunities and innovative ways to monetize our audiences and content. Lead a commercial team that thinks and sells like partnership builders and generates strategic value of the relationships they own.

The Opportunity Affiliate partnerships play a key role in driving growth across digital products and platforms. In this role, you’ll be responsible for building, managing, and scaling affiliate relationships across LATAM, working closely with internal teams to ensure performance, quality traffic, and sustainable long-term growth. This position is ideal for someone who already understands the affiliate ecosystem in Latin America , has experience working with performance-based partnerships, and enjoys developing strategic relationships with affiliates and media partners. items.title: Senior Affiliate Business Development Manager (13 Month Maternity Cover)
items.description: The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving new affiliate business growth, owning the affiliate onboarding and incubation process, and governing affiliate deal management standards across the Affiliate Team. The role is accountable for identifying, onboarding, activating, and validating new affiliate partnerships before transferring commercial ownership to an Account Manager. In addition, the role owns affiliate deal governance processes, commercial reporting, market intelligence, and continuous improvement initiatives that support scalable growth. The Business Development Manager works closely with Account Managers, Analytics, Finance, Compliance, and Market Teams to ensure all affiliate partnerships are launched efficiently, comply with internal standards, and deliver sustainable commercial value. Key Responsibilities & Areas of Ownership New Business Development Identify, evaluate, and pursue new affiliate partnership opportunities in strategic markets. Build and manage relationships with prospective affiliates during the acquisition and onboarding phase. Conduct commercial assessments of potential partners, including traffic quality, commercial viability, and strategic fit. Negotiate initial commercial terms within approved deal frameworks and escalation thresholds. Develop market-entry affiliate pipelines for new and emerging markets Primary Ownership Own and continuously improve the Affiliate Onboarding & Incubation function. Affiliate onboarding coordination. Deal setup and platform configuration. Campaign launch preparation. Tracking validation and attribution verification. Initial traffic review and quality assessment. Early-life performance monitoring. First-stage commercial optimization. Handover Ownership The Business Development Manager remains accountable until all of the following are completed: Traffic sources have been reviewed and approved. Affiliate is contractually onboarded. Affiliate has launched live traffic. Tracking has been validated. Initial performance review has been completed. Following successful completion of these stages, ownership transfers to the assigned Account Manager. Deal Governance & Process Management Primary Ownership : Own the affiliate deal governance framework and associated operational processes. Maintaining deal approval procedures and documentation standards. Driving process efficiency and consistency across markets. Ensuring commercial frameworks are aligned with approved business rules and governance requirements. Identifying process improvements and standardization opportunities. Second-Level Deal Review : Act as second-level reviewer for affiliate deals prior to final approval. Commercial rationale. Compliance with approval thresholds. Budget alignment. Consistency with established market standards. Documentation completeness. Not Responsible For : Final commercial ownership of affiliate agreements. Ongoing commercial negotiations with existing affiliates. Market budget ownership. Approved Traffic Source Governance Maintain the central repository of approved affiliate traffic sources and market-specific commercial models. Maintaining records of approved traffic acquisition methods. Documenting market-specific restrictions and requirements. Tracking applicable commercial frameworks and profit-share structures. Coordinating updates with Compliance, Legal, Brand, and Market stakeholders. Market Intelligence & Commercial Benchmarking Primary Ownership : Monitor and report on affiliate market developments across key markets. Competitor commercial benchmarking. Market trend analysis. Emerging affiliate model identification. Acquisition channel monitoring. Industry best-practice sharing. Deliverables : Quarterly key market intelligence summaries. Competitor deal benchmark reviews for key markets. Recommendations for commercial optimization. New Market Assessment Support Support the Head of Affiliates in evaluating new market opportunities. Responsibilities include: Affiliate landscape assessments. Competitor mapping. Commercial opportunity analysis. Affiliate acquisition strategy recommendations. Market launch readiness evaluations. Training & Team Enablement Act as the subject matter expert for affiliate deal governance, onboarding processes, and commercial best practices. Responsibilities include: Delivering training sessions. Supporting onboarding of new team members. Maintaining process documentation. Promoting consistent adoption of best practices. Providing guidance on affiliate-specific use of MyAffiliates, Palantir, Power BI, and related tools. Key Performance Indicators The Business Development Manager will primarily be measured on: Business Development New qualified affiliates onboarded Revenue contribution from new affiliates onboarded Strategic affiliate acquisitions Onboarding & Incubation Time-to-launch Time-to-NDC Incubation portfolio performance Deal Governance Deal approval SLA adherence Deal approval Compliance with approval frameworks Process efficiency improvements Reporting quality and accuracy Strategic Contribution Market intelligence outputs Commercial optimization recommendations By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Key Account Manager - Belgium
items.description: Outstanding opportunity to join Betsson Group as our new Key Account Manager - Belgium Role Overview We are seeking a dynamic and customer-centric Key Account Manager to join our team in Malta. This role is pivotal in building strong relationships with our most valuable customers and ensuring a best-in-class service experience that drives loyalty, engagement, and revenue growth. As the face of our brand to our VIP clients, you will be responsible for direct and personalized communication, proactive engagement, and tailored hospitality at exclusive events. You will work cross-functionally to ensure VIP customer satisfaction, retention, and increased lifetime value. Key Responsibilities Account Management: Manage a portfolio of VIP customers with a high degree of personalization and care, maintaining frequent and proactive contact through phone, email, messaging apps, and in-person meetings. Revenue & Retention Growth: Monitor and analyse individual customer KPIs (e.g., activity, deposits, net revenue, churn risk), and develop action plans to increase engagement and extend customer lifetime value. Event Hosting & Hospitality: Act as the primary host for VIP clients during exclusive company events (e.g., football/basketball games, dinners, tournaments), ensuring a premium, seamless, and unforgettable experience. Weekend Availability: Be available on weekends and evenings to manage the VIP shift—communicating with customers, solving issues, and providing real-time support when needed. Client Feedback & Insight: Collect feedback and identify trends within the VIP base to share with internal teams for service and product optimization. Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with key central functions including VIP & CRM, Payments, Risk, and Product teams to ensure a holistic customer experience. Regularly report on VIP activity, risk exposure, and performance against KPIs. Qualifications & Experience Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar VIP management or customer-facing account management role, ideally within the iGaming , luxury hospitality , entertainment , or sports sectors. Proven track record in building long-term relationships , managing customer portfolios, and achieving revenue growth targets. Deep understanding of the online gambling ecosystem, player behaviours, and VIP lifecycle management is a strong plus. Skills & Requirements Fluent in Dutch and English , both written and spoken. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. High degree of empathy , discretion , and professionalism when dealing with high-value clients. Ability to analyse data and derive actionable insights. Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Willingness and flexibility to work weekends , evenings , and attend events . Passion for sports is a big plus. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Head of Commercial Operations
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring a Head of Commercial Operations to lead the operational engine behind our Commercial function. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can take commercial ambition and turn it into scalable, high-performing execution. You’ll own how we onboard and manage partners, optimise merchandising across our portfolio, execute commercial opportunities and build the systems, processes and ways of working that enable us to grow efficiently. You’ll lead our Account Operations and Commercial Operations teams, creating greater structure, accountability and consistency while continuously looking for ways to make us faster and smarter through better data, automation and AI. This is an opportunity to shape how Commercial Operations works at Legend, building an operation that can scale with the business while directly contributing to revenue growth. Your Impact: Build a best-in-class partner onboarding engine: Own and improve the journey from commercial opportunity through onboarding to revenue, reducing friction, accelerating time-to-value and creating a consistent experience for our partners. Turn merchandising into a measurable growth lever: Lead the optimisation of placement, visibility and performance across our portfolio, using data, testing and commercial insight to identify opportunities to unlock incremental revenue. Create scalable Commercial Operations: Simplify and standardise processes across Account Operations and Commercial Operations, introducing clearer ownership, governance and ways of working that can support continued business growth. Use technology, automation and AI to make us better: Identify opportunities to remove manual work, improve workflows and strengthen decision-making through our commercial tooling, automation, AI and better use of data. Make commercial opportunities happen: Partner closely with Commercial, Marketing and other teams to turn ideas into well-executed launches, promotions and initiatives, ensuring operational readiness and measurable commercial outcomes. Build a high-performing team: Lead, develop and empower the Account Operations and Commercial Operations teams, creating clear accountability, strong performance standards and a culture focused on continuous improvement. What You'll Bring: Significant experience leading Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Partner Operations or a similar function in a fast-paced, commercially driven business. A strong commercial mindset, you understand how operational decisions ultimately influence revenue, partner performance and customer experience, rather than viewing operations purely as process. Proven experience improving and scaling operational processes, with examples of taking complex or manual ways of working and making them simpler, faster and more effective. Strong experience using data, systems and commercial tooling to improve performance, with an interest in how automation and AI can transform operational workflows. The ability to operate strategically while remaining close enough to execution to make things happen, comfortable setting the direction, solving problems and driving delivery. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bring teams together, challenge constructively and create accountability across different functions. The Interview Process: Initial conversation with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom Hiring Manager Interview - 60-minute Zoom interview with the hiring manager, focused on your experience, leadership approach and how you’ve delivered impact in similar environments. Task & Presentation - A take-home task with time to prepare, followed by a 60-minute Zoom session where you’ll present your approach and discuss it with members of the team. Final Interview - 60-minute Zoom conversation with senior stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to meet more of the team and explore the role, business and opportunity in more depth. Additional Information When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com , and we'll do all we can to support you.

items.title: Senior Affiliates Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel. Your Responsibilities As our Senior Affiliate Manager DACH , you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships. End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management: Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets. Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"): Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks. Key Account Growth ("Farming"): Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised. Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion: Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products. Operational & Tracking Excellence: Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds). Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control: Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels. Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy: Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company. Your Profile Must-Haves Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region. Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends. Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes. Strong Interpersonal & Negotiation Skills: Excellent communication skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude and a strong commitment to team collaboration and problem-solving. Language Proficiency: Business fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is required to manage partner relationships and engage effectively within our international team. Nice-to-Haves FinTech & Financial Product Interest: Prior experience or strong curiosity regarding personal finance, banking products, investments, or pension topics. Tool Familiarity: Practical experience working with CRM and affiliate software platforms such as HubSpot, Impact, or similar enterprise partner management suites. AI & Automation Curiosity: Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to streamline routine partner communication, market research, or operational workflows. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel. Your Responsibilities As our Senior Affiliate Manager DACH , you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships. End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management: Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets. Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"): Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks. Key Account Growth ("Farming"): Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised. Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion: Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products. Operational & Tracking Excellence: Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds). Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control: Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels. Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy: Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company. Your Profile Must-Haves Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region. Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends. Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes. items.title: Commercial Operations Team Lead
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring a Commercial Operations Team Lead to join our Commercial team and lead a talented team responsible for keeping the data and operational processes behind our partnerships running accurately, efficiently and at pace. This isn't a traditional Data Analyst role. It's an operations leadership role in a data-rich environment. You'll take ownership of a busy, deadline-driven operation, helping your team manage large volumes of commercial data accurately while continually looking for smarter ways to work. You'll spot bottlenecks, challenge inefficient processes and use automation, technology and AI to help us scale. Just as importantly, you'll lead the people behind the operation. We want someone who knows how to delegate, develop a team, protect their capacity and create an environment where people can perform at their best, even when things get busy. If you're the kind of leader who sees a complicated process and immediately starts thinking about how to make it simpler, faster and better, this could be a great opportunity for you. Your Impact: Lead and develop a high-performing team, creating clear priorities, delegating effectively and building a positive culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to do their best work. Own critical commercial operations cycles, ensuring large volumes of data are reviewed, processed and delivered accurately against demanding daily and monthly deadlines. Make our operation smarter, identifying bottlenecks and manual processes and introducing improvements through better workflows, automation, AI and technology. Get to the root of problems, spotting anomalies and investigating whether issues sit within data, mapping, logic or process before recommending practical solutions. Manage competing priorities, understanding team capacity, escalating risks early and confidently challenging or reprioritising work when everything can't happen at once. Help us scale, building processes that can handle increasing volume and complexity without relying on simply adding more people. What You'll Bring: Strong people leadership experience within a fast-paced operations environment, with the ability to delegate, coach, motivate and manage a busy team rather than trying to do everything yourself. A process-improvement mindset and examples of where you've simplified, automated or redesigned operational workflows to improve efficiency, quality or scalability. Strong analytical and logical thinking. You don't need to be a Data Analyst or know SQL, but you should be comfortable working with large volumes of data, spotting trends and anomalies and investigating root causes. Confidence working to tight deadlines and managing competing priorities, with the judgement to know what needs immediate attention, what can wait and when something needs escalating. A proactive, solutions-focused approach. You don't just identify problems, you investigate them, bring ideas and help move things forward. Confidence with Excel and operational systems, alongside the curiosity to learn new tools quickly and explore how technology and AI can improve the way your team works. The Interview Process: We want our interview process to give you a genuine feel for the role, the team and the challenges you'll be taking on while giving us the opportunity to understand how you think, lead and solve problems. 1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner – 30 minutes via Zoom 2nd: Interview with our Commercial Team – we'll explore your experience across people leadership, operations, process improvement and problem-solving through real examples and situational questions. 3rd: Take-Home Task - You'll be given a short take-home task based on realistic scenarios you could encounter in the role. Final: Task Discussion & Leadership Interview - You'll meet with our Head of Commercial Optimisation and People Partner to discuss your approach to the task and explore your leadership style, operational judgement and how you would approach some of the real challenges you'll face in the role. We'll give you everything you need to prepare ahead of each stage. Additional Information When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com , and we'll do all we can to support you.

items.title: Manager, Revenue Planning and Analytics
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. As the market leader in sports technology, Sportradar (NASDAQ: SRAD) is positioned at the center of the sports ecosystem. Our broader Financial Planning & Analysis organization plays a critical role in delivering extraordinary growth; we’re targeting a 15% CAGR for revenue while consistently expanding margin and cash conversion. In an industry where AI is redefining fan engagement, our finance leaders must be as sophisticated as our technology: combining financial discipline with commercial acumen and advanced analytics to unlock opportunities across a market growing at double-digit percent annually. THE CHALLENGE Reporting to the VP of Revenue Performance & Planning, you are the primary performance auditor of commercial outcomes. You don't just report numbers; you interrogate them and recommend the way forward to maximize value. Your mission is to identify the "why" behind performance trends that you package to a compelling story to drive a business decision. You provide the critical challenge required for driving revenue and margin, guiding business counterparts through a transformative planning process that prioritizes drivers over pure outcomes. Proactive revenue performance analysis: move past outcomes to identify the specific revenue drivers (e.g., usage, churn, pricing, market) that management must focus on. Revenue forecast pressure-testing: Interrogate the inputs that feed our global P&L to ensure every forecast is achievable and rooted in actionable drivers. Logic refinement: Identify and dismantle broken assumptions in commercial plans and rebuild them into actionable, robust frameworks. Causal synthesis: Translate complex technical and commercial data into clear, authoritative narratives for senior stakeholders. Key responsibilities Driver autopsy: Conduct deep-dives into revenue beats or misses to distinguish between one-time windfalls and core structural trends. Planning guidance: Lead commercial counterparts through the forecasting and budgeting process to ensure submissions are robust and logically sound. Business modeling: Create elegant solutions for complex business topics like pricing elasticity and market entry costs. Build automated revenue reporting using advanced analytical and reporting tools on top of data warehouse and billing data sets to steer commercial decision making ABOUT YOU You ask smart questions and refuse to accept surface-level explanations. You enable business success by providing the "so-what" that others miss. You are a "fixer" who enjoys the challenge of untangling messy data problems to find a clear path forward. What we're looking for Experience : 3-5 years in a multidisciplinary finance, analytics, and/or consulting role. Archetype : We seek high proficiency in either commercial finance or commercial analytics. Education : MBA or relevant master’s degree preferred. Technical requirement : SQL, Power BI / Tableau, and AI agents knowledge is essential. Experience with Python or n8n/workflow automation is highly valued. Mindset : An "accountability" mindset - you value the strength of a plan over the speed of its delivery. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment : Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

items.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Public Sector
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to public sector organisations across Spain. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic agreements with central government ministries, regional and local administrations, and public agencies. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the public sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to public sector stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in citizen services, administration, and research. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with public sector decision-makers. The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help public institutions obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI. Responsibilities: Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the public sector in Spain. Navigate complex public institutions to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to public procurement cycles and budgeting processes, including tenders, framework agreements, and partner or resale routes, to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse public sector landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within ministries, agencies, and administrative departments. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for public sector applications Navigate complex public sector stakeholder ecosystems including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus Lead conversations with customers on data sovereignty, security, and compliance, working with Security, Legal, and Product colleagues on how we meet those requirements Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from public sector users and conveying public sector needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for public institutions Continuously refine the public sector sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency You may be a good fit if you have: 7+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies, including selling to public sector organisations in Spain A track record of managing complex sales cycles within public institutions and securing strategic agreements by understanding both technical requirements and public sector use cases Practical command of Spanish public procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, central purchasing bodies, and partner or resale routes Demonstrated ability to navigate public sector organisational structures, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including senior officials, digital and technology leaders, and IT departments Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various public sector audiences, from technical teams to senior officials Deep understanding of public sector buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including data sovereignty, security, and compliance requirements A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the public sector market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, with excellent written and spoken communication in both A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for use by public institutions Nice to have: familiarity with the security and compliance frameworks that apply to technology purchasing in the Spanish public sector. Acerca del puesto Como Enterprise Account Executive en Anthropic, te incorporarás al equipo fundacional que está a la vanguardia de la introducción de nuestra API de productividad con IA de última generación y de nuestras soluciones SaaS en las organizaciones del sector público en España. Impulsarás la adopción de una IA de vanguardia y segura mediante acuerdos estratégicos con ministerios de la Administración General del Estado, administraciones autonómicas y locales y organismos públicos. Pondrás tu experiencia en venta consultiva en el sector público al servicio del crecimiento de los ingresos y te convertirás en un socio de confianza para los interlocutores del sector, ayudándoles a integrar y desplegar la IA y a descubrir todo su potencial en los servicios a la ciudadanía, la administración y la investigación. En colaboración con los equipos de GTM, Producto y Marketing, perfeccionarás de forma continua nuestra propuesta de valor, nuestra metodología de ventas y nuestro posicionamiento para que conecten con quienes toman las decisiones en el sector público. El perfil ideal siente pasión por desarrollar nuevos segmentos de mercado, identificar oportunidades de alto potencial y ejecutar las estrategias que permiten aprovecharlas. Al impulsar el despliegue de los productos emergentes de Anthropic, ayudarás a las instituciones públicas a adquirir nuevas capacidades y contribuirás al desarrollo ético de la IA. Responsabilidades: Conseguir nuevos clientes y generar ingresos para Anthropic en el sector público en España. Orientarte en instituciones públicas complejas para llegar a las personas clave en la toma de decisiones, darles a conocer nuestros servicios y ayudarles a tener éxito con Anthropic. Serás responsable de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta el cierre. Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias comerciales innovadoras adaptadas a los ciclos de contratación pública y a los procesos presupuestarios, incluidas las licitaciones, los acuerdos marco y las vías de venta a través de partners o revendedores, para alcanzar y superar los objetivos de ingresos. Analizar el panorama, las tendencias y la dinámica del sector público para convertir los planes estratégicos en acciones y campañas comerciales específicas. Liderar la expansión en el mercado identificando nuevos casos de uso en ministerios, organismos y departamentos administrativos. Colaborar de forma transversal para diferenciar nuestra oferta en las aplicaciones del sector público. Desenvolverte en ecosistemas complejos de interlocutores del sector público (altos cargos, responsables de transformación digital y tecnología, departamentos de TI y órganos de contratación) para generar consenso. Liderar las conversaciones con los clientes sobre soberanía del dato, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo, trabajando con los equipos de Seguridad, Legal y Producto en la forma en que respondemos a esos requisitos. Contribuir a la hoja de ruta y a las funcionalidades del producto recogiendo las opiniones de las personas usuarias del sector público y trasladando sus necesidades. Aportar ideas que refuercen nuestra propuesta de valor para las instituciones públicas. Perfeccionar de forma continua la metodología de ventas para el sector público incorporando lo aprendido a playbooks, plantillas y buenas prácticas. Identificar mejoras de proceso que optimicen la productividad y la coherencia comerciales. Este puesto puede encajar contigo si tienes: Al menos 7 años de experiencia en ventas B2B (SaaS, soluciones API o tecnologías emergentes), incluida la venta a organizaciones del sector público en España Una trayectoria demostrada en la gestión de ciclos de venta complejos en instituciones públicas y en el cierre de acuerdos estratégicos, basada en la comprensión tanto de los requisitos técnicos como de los casos de uso del sector público Un dominio práctico de la contratación pública española: licitaciones, acuerdos marco, centrales de compras y vías de venta a través de partners o revendedores Capacidad demostrada para desenvolverte en las estructuras organizativas del sector público y generar consenso entre interlocutores diversos, entre ellos altos cargos, responsables de transformación digital y tecnología y departamentos de TI Experiencia contrastada superando objetivos de ingresos gracias a una gestión eficaz de un pipeline y un proceso de venta en constante evolución Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y soltura para presentar ante públicos diversos del sector público, desde equipos técnicos hasta altos cargos Un conocimiento profundo de los ciclos de compra, los procesos de decisión y los principales retos del sector público, incluidos los requisitos de soberanía del dato, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo Un enfoque estratégico y analítico del mercado del sector público, combinado con una ejecución táctica y creativa para aprovechar las oportunidades Nivel bilingüe de español e inglés, con una excelente comunicación oral y escrita en ambos idiomas Pasión por los sistemas avanzados de IA y sus aplicaciones, o experiencia con ellos. Te importa de verdad que los sistemas de IA de vanguardia se desarrollen de forma segura y ética para su uso por parte de las instituciones públicas. Se valorará: familiaridad con los marcos de seguridad y cumplimiento normativo aplicables a la contratación de tecnología en el sector público español. Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Head of Business Development
items.description: We are looking for a results-driven Head of Business Development with a strong background in the iGaming B2B sector, specifically within game providers or aggregators. The role focuses on expanding content distribution through strategic aggregator partnerships, entering new markets, and driving revenue growth. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can establish commercial processes from the ground up, leverage existing industry relationships, and manage the entire partnership lifecycle from initial outreach to successful game launches. Responsibilities - Drive international business expansion by securing new aggregator partnerships and increasing game distribution across their operator networks, with direct operator deals as a secondary priority - Identify and engage prospective partners across Tier-1 markets, Latin America, and Europe, evaluating opportunities based on commercial potential, market fit, and distribution reach - Manage the complete business development cycle, from prospecting and qualification to commercial negotiations, contract execution, technical integration, and go-live - Build relationships with decision-makers at aggregator and operator companies, conduct discovery meetings, present the game portfolio, and negotiate revenue-sharing agreements - Develop compelling commercial proposals using game characteristics and performance indicators, including RTP, volatility, themes, retention, and average bet - Establish and maintain an effective CRM and sales pipeline framework, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, structured follow-ups, and reliable revenue forecasts - Identify and engage potential aggregator and operator partners through targeted outreach, industry networking, and participation in major events such as SiGMA, ICE, and iGB - Work closely with Product, Compliance, and Integration teams to facilitate partner onboarding, resolve licensing or technical challenges, and accelerate content launches - Share market insights with Product teams, including competitor performance, portfolio opportunities, localization requirements, and regional player preferences - Take ownership of partner-generated GGR, monitor commercial performance, and provide the CEO with weekly pipeline updates, monthly revenue reports by partner and market, and quarterly forecasts for signings, launches, and GGR - Identify potential commercial or operational obstacles early and escalate critical issues directly to the CEO to avoid delays Requirements - 2+ years of business development experience within an iGaming game provider or aggregator — mandatory - Strong understanding of the B2B game distribution ecosystem, including aggregator-led sales models, RGS and integration processes, licensing, certification, and revenue-sharing structures - Established professional relationships with aggregators and operators across Tier-1 markets, Europe, and Latin America, with a particularly strong network on the aggregator side - Demonstrated success in bringing gaming content to market through aggregator partnerships - Proven ability to build new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, cold outreach, LinkedIn campaigns, and industry networking, including events such as SiGMA, ICE, and iGB - Good understanding of ICP development, lead qualification, and B2B sales funnels, with the ability to prioritize high-impact aggregator partnerships over individual operator deals - Confident in managing commercial discussions with mid-level and C-level stakeholders, from initial discovery to negotiating partnership terms and revenue-sharing models - Entrepreneurial approach and the ability to establish business development processes, CRM workflows, and sales pipelines from scratch - Analytical mindset with an understanding of iGaming performance metrics, including RTP, volatility, player retention, and average bet, and the ability to translate these insights into effective commercial presentations - Experience working with CRM platforms, maintaining accurate records, managing follow-ups, and monitoring deal progression - Upper-Intermediate (B2) to Advanced (C1) English, with strong communication and negotiation skills - Persistence and adaptability when dealing with complex negotiations, extended integration timelines, and unsuccessful sales opportunities - Availability for international business travel, including industry conferences and partner meetings What's in it for you - Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world - 20 working days of paid annual leave and 15 working days of paid sick leave - Public holidays - Opportunity to make a direct impact on international expansion and commercial growth - Room for professional development and career progression as the business scales - Open and collaborative working environment that encourages feedback, initiative, and recognition of individual contributions

items.title: Sales Manager - Native Russian Speaking (m/f/x)
items.description: bwise Media is dedicated to connecting brands with sports audiences through the powerful combination of data, creativity, and technology. With a strong focus on delivering measurable results for sports brands worldwide, our work is built around four core pillars: Direct Media Buying, Sponsorships & Activations, Performance Marketing, and our proprietary In-House AdTech solutions. We are looking for a driven and ambitious Sales Manager (Native Russian Speaker) to join our team in Vienna. In this role, you will play a key part in expanding our presence within Russian-speaking markets, focusing on client acquisition and long-term partnership development in the iGaming sector . Knowing the fundamentals of digital advertising - such as CPM, traffic sources, media buying, and campaign optimization - is a must have . Ideally you already have experience within the iGaming industry . If you're passionate about digital advertising and the iGaming landscape, we'd love to hear from you! Responsibilities After an in-depth onboarding and training with our Global Business Development Director, you will: Identify and acquire new clients within Russian-speaking markets. Execute strategic sales plans to drive revenue growth. Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships. Present and sell digital advertising solutions tailored to client needs. Negotiate commercial terms and close high-value deals. Attend industry events, conferences, and networking meetings (online & offline). Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution. Requirements A strong understanding of digital advertising fundamentals (CPM, CPC, CPA, traffic types, media buying, etc.) is mandatory . Previous experience as sales/marketing manager , ideally within the iGaming industry. items.description: [Full-time] • Remote At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence. With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future. About This Role We're looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own paid user acquisition end to end. You'll own the paid budget, the channel mix, and the number. Today, that means search and paid social do the heavy lifting; from there, you'll decide where we expand next—CTV, podcast, and paid sponsorships, or somewhere we haven't tried yet. You'll make that call based on what the data says, not what's fashionable. This is a hands-on role with real scope. You'll be in the accounts, writing copy, setting up landing page tests, reporting out on the numbers, and hitting our CAC targets. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, and closely with data, product, lifecycle, and creative partners. If you like to be hands-on while driving the strategy, this is a good fit. Own the paid media budget: allocation across channels, pacing, and reallocation away from non efficient spend toward what's working Run end-to-end campaign management—strategy, build, launch, optimization, analysis, and reporting Optimize account performance through ongoing keyword work, ad copy testing, campaign structure improvements, and bid strategy Build a consistent testing cadence across ad copy, creative formats, audiences, targeting, and landing pages, and turn results into a documented learning loop Partner with product and design to improve landing page and funnel conversion rates, bringing specific recommendations rather than general feedback Manage performance against efficiency targets (CAC, LTV:CAC, CPA, ROAS) rather than top-of-funnel volume alone, and connect paid spend to registrations, trial starts, and new customer revenue. items.title: Head of Digital Natives & Startups, ANZ
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking a Head of Digital Natives & Startups, ANZ to build and lead Anthropic's go-to-market motion for digital native businesses and startups across Australia and New Zealand. You will grow a team that wins and expands the region's fastest-moving, AI-forward companies, driving consumption of Claude directly and through our cloud partners. You will set the segment strategy, hire and develop the team, and work closely with Product, Partnerships and Marketing to turn ANZ builders into long-term customers. This is a chance to shape how one of the world's most dynamic startup ecosystems adopts frontier AI, while representing ANZ's priorities to our global leadership. Key responsibilities Define and execute the ANZ go-to-market strategy for Digital Natives and Startups, covering both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts Build, hire and lead a high-performing sales team across Australia and New Zealand, with clear targets, regular coaching and defined career paths Own pipeline, forecast and consumption targets for the segment, running a consumption-based sales motion Build a repeatable motion across the customer lifecycle, from early-stage founders to scaled, high-growth digital natives Develop strong relationships across the ANZ startup ecosystem, including founders, venture investors, accelerators and developer communities Partner with cloud providers and our Partnerships team to co-sell and extend our reach in the segment Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Solutions and Customer Success to adapt our offering and messaging for ANZ, and bring customer feedback back to the business Represent ANZ priorities to regional and global leadership, and keep local execution aligned with global strategy Act as an executive sponsor for key customers and communicate Anthropic's trust and safety principles with credibility Minimum qualifications 15+ years of overall experience selling technology products to enterprise organisations across ANZ market 5+ years of people management experience leading sales teams in the digital native and/or startup segment Proven success in consumption-based technology sales, such as cloud, API or usage-based SaaS Experience building a business or team from the ground up in Australia and/or New Zealand Track record across both customer acquisition and account growth Strong network and credibility in the ANZ startup and digital native ecosystem Ability to explain technical products clearly to founders, engineers and executives Preferred qualifications Background at Google, AWS or a similar cloud or SaaS company Experience selling AI, machine learning or developer-focused products Experience co-selling with cloud partners and working with channel Experience hiring and scaling a team through rapid growth Familiarity with the ANZ regulatory and data-privacy landscape Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Account Manager
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for an Account Executive at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. Obsessed with live streaming, gaming and the creator economy? Fluent in digital advertising and programmatic buying but want to build something monumental rather than just clock into a traditional, slow moving media network. This is your sandbox. We’re after someone hungry to execute, scale and close revenue generating ad sales opportunities as our global presence takes off. What you’ll build with us: This is a dynamic commercial role for a highly independent operator who thrives in high growth environments, creating their own templates, processes and workflows while getting deals done. Expect to drive net new revenue and manage the campaign lifecycle from pitch through to optimisation, upsells and cross-sells, monetising KICK's explosive global inventory of display, video and branded placements. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Sydney office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who are we? Headquartered in the beautiful city of Melbourne, Australia, KICK is built by gamers, for gamers. Our platform may be new, but we're already making waves by partnering with some of the biggest names in streaming! We’re not just another live streaming platform though - we’re a community of gamers, creators, and fans who are passionate about building something incredible together, and we’re already seeing the results of our hard work: Our platform is quickly becoming one of the fastest growing forces in the industry. Fast forward to today, we have more than 100 million users and recently celebrated 1 billion watch hours, and we are just getting started. Our founders have spent the last two decades playing video games together and fueled by their extensive knowledge, experience, and deep love for tech, they have turned their passion into a number of thriving entertainment and gaming brands. This passion for gaming, has led to KICK being recognised as an industry disruptor and the ones to watch, making us the ultimate destination for gamers and creators alike. Kickstart your career and apply today! The impact you’ll make: Ad Sales & Pipeline Management Own the execution of the ad sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, pitching, negotiating, and closing media deals with brands and agencies. Maintain a clean and healthy commercial pipeline within CRM and Order Management tools, ensuring reliable deal tracking and revenue projections. Assist in developing and refining client-facing materials, media kits, and rate cards tailored to the fast-evolving needs of international advertisers. Negotiate insertion orders (IOs), programmatic access (PMPs/PG), and custom brand integrations. Actively contribute to meeting and exceeding group commercial milestones as KICK’s global monetization capability scales. Post-Sales Support & Account Growth Monitor active campaigns to ensure successful execution, tracking client delivery and maximising ROI performance metrics. Act as a dedicated commercial point of contact post-sale, identifying organic paths to secure campaign renewals, cross-sells, and programmatic spend expansions. External Engagement & Cross-functional Delivery Work hand-in-hand with the Creator Partnerships team to monetise international campaign leads, cross-selling ad placements into secondary markets and activating commercial pipeline opportunities brought in by the partnerships ecosystem. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform delivering a secure infrastructure for moving, storing, and issuing digital assets & cryptocurrencies. At Fireblocks, we enable businesses to securely build, run and scale digital asset operations through the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure. Our next-generation multi-layer technology protects Digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Fireblocks is the only platform that provides insurance for digital assets in storage, transfer, and E&O. As of January 2026, we serve over 2,400 institutional customers, have secured the transfer of over $10 trillion in digital assets, and are the world's highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised. Our mission is simple: Enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale Here’s the bit about the opportunity: As part of the Fireblocks sales team, you will play a meaningful role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the Blockchain and Cybersecurity field. You’ll target a mixture of Crypto-Native and Financial Services accounts in the UK, working closely with Sales Engineers and the Business Development team. You’ll be: Achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets Working closely with the Fireblocks BDR and GTM Team Building and maintaining relationships with prospects and customers Prospect, territory, and account planning Updating and maintaining Fireblocks CRM You’ll bring: Enterprise sales experience in software or institutional sales, selling into a relevant space of financial services, crypto, blockchain or fintech Understanding of blockchain technology and cryptocurrency Direct experience working within financial services, cybersecurity, or cryptocurrency is preferred Track record of over-achievement Entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude with a willingness to prospect Worked in a team-selling environment We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for those who want to work with some of the industry's most talented contributors. You should bring a track record of success and experience closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sector. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .
