items.title: Affiliate Manager
items.description: Work with the Best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold – concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network Orderly's affiliate manager is responsible for building and managing a company's affiliate program, including recruiting new affiliates, maintaining relationships with existing ones, and negotiating contracts: What will you be working on? Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the affiliate marketing landscape, including industry trends, emerging technologies, and key players in the crypto and blockchain space. Identify, source, and onboard the right set of affiliate partners to align with the company's product goals and business strategy. Build, maintain, and grow strong relationships with top affiliates globally, ensuring long-term partnerships and mutual success. Manage and optimize relationships with existing affiliates and clients, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with business objectives. Collaborate with affiliate partners and internal teams to design and implement campaigns; work closely with Product and Engineering teams to address affiliate needs and ensure seamless integration and execution. Who will you be working with? Maintain close collaboration with the Marketing , Operations , Product , and Business Development teams to ensure cohesive strategies and streamlined processes. About you The ability to build relationships and manage a diverse community The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Knowledge of affiliate networks Exceptional planning and project management skills Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.

items.title: Sales Director, Enterprise
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role In this role, you'll lead a team of Account Executives driving the adoption of safe, frontier AI with top enterprises across Korea. This role is critical to Anthropic's APAC expansion. You'll leverage your leadership expertise to propel revenue growth while developing a high-performing team. Working closely with Applied AI Engineering, Product, GTM, and Marketing teams, you'll help enterprise customers deploy AI solutions and refine our market positioning for Korea. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Korean business culture, a passion for developing people, and the ability to navigate Korea's relationship-driven, conglomerate-centric enterprise sales environment. Key responsibilities Build and lead a high-performing team of Account Executives, providing coaching, mentorship, and guidance to drive team success Develop and implement sales strategies tailored to enterprise procurement cycles and budgeting processes to meet and exceed team revenue quotas Create and maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline management, and reporting while ensuring data integrity in CRM systems Partner with Enablement to develop training programs and resources that accelerate AE ramp time and effectiveness, with focus on Korean enterprise buying cycles and decision-making processes Work closely with Applied AI Engineering teams to demonstrate technical capabilities pre-sales and optimize solutions post-sales Enable your team to have credible technical conversations about AI applications while maintaining appropriate guardrails Build strong partnerships across the organization to drive strategic initiatives Identify and execute on new market opportunities and use cases for Anthropic's AI solutions across enterprise segments, including Korea's large conglomerates and fast-growing digital-native companies Help your team navigate complex enterprise stakeholder ecosystems including executives, IT departments, and procurement offices to build alignment Preferred qualifications 15+ years of enterprise sales experience, preferably driving adoption of SaaS or emerging technologies 5+ years of sales leadership experience within the Enterprise segment Proven track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams selling into large enterprises, with demonstrated success in coaching and developing AEs Experience establishing and scaling sales processes, tools, and methodologies in fast-growing organizations Strong technical acumen with ability to enable credible AI conversations Track record of successful partnership with technical teams throughout the customer journey Deep understanding of enterprise buying cycles, procurement frameworks, and common pain points across industries Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multithreaded sales cycles across diverse stakeholder groups and drive cross-functional initiatives Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles and helping AEs secure strategic deals Excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships across all levels, from individual contributors to C-suite executives Strategic approach to market analysis combined with tactical excellence in execution Passion for AI technology and commitment to its safe, responsible development Business-level Korean required; English proficiency strongly preferred Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Paid Media Partnerships Lead
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We're looking for a Paid Media Partnerships Lead to be a senior leader within the Paid Media team at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. What you’ll build with us: This role is integral to the execution of Easygo's regional and global media strategies, owning the full lifecycle of digital media partnerships from identification and assessment through to negotiation, execution, and ongoing management. This is a commercially minded, strategically led role that sits at the intersection of partnerships, brand, and performance. The Paid Media Partnerships Lead will represent the Paid Media team in integrated, cross-format opportunities that include events, ambassador deals, and sponsorships with media assets. The role requires close collaboration with the Sponsorship team, country managers, and channel leads to ensure all partnership activity is aligned with brand positioning, performance objectives, and market strategy. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Partnership Strategy & Opportunity Identification Proactively identify, evaluate and prioritise digital media partnership opportunities across global and regional markets, balancing always-on investment with event and activation-led deals. Develop and maintain a structured opportunity pipeline, assessing each opportunity against clearly defined criteria across brand positioning, awareness, market authority and acquisition objectives. Build and apply a rigorous partner/publisher assessment framework, defining evaluation criteria tailored to different business objectives and ensuring a consistent, data-informed approach to partnership selection. Maintain visibility of global opportunities (relevant to .com) alongside the ability to identify cross-market efficiencies, for example, a single partnership that spans all LatAm markets rather than negotiating each individually. Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead the negotiation of partnership agreements including commercial terms, media commitments, exclusivity arrangements, deliverable guarantees, and renewal conditions. Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle for all digital media partnerships, from initial terms through to execution, performance review, renewal and renegotiation. Drive commercial rigour across the portfolio, ensuring Easygo consistently achieves favourable terms and measurable returns on all partnership investment. Oversee the investment budget in collaboration with regional leads, allocating spend across the portfolio in line with strategic priorities and performance outcomes. Direct Publisher Relationships Own and develop Easygo's direct publisher relationships, building a preferred partner network of premium media owners across key markets and categories. Lead the negotiation and management of direct inventory deals, including tenancy packages, sponsorship integrations, content partnerships and bespoke placement arrangements. Work in close collaboration with the Programmatic Lead to identify where SSP relationships and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals can complement or replace direct arrangements - bringing a commercial and strategic lens to inventory decisions while the Programmatic Lead owns technical execution. Collaborate with the Programmatic Lead on the development of PMPs for both always-on activity and short-term event-led activations (e.g. World Cup, major sporting events) - owning the commercial negotiation and deal structure while the Programmatic Lead governs technical setup and delivery. Integrated & Cross-Format Opportunities Represent the Paid Media team in integrated, cross-format partnership opportunities including events, ambassador deals, sponsorships with media assets and multi-channel activations. Collaborate closely with the Sponsorship team and relevant country managers to align paid media partnership strategy with broader sponsorship, brand and market initiatives. Ensure paid media assets within integrated deals are clearly scoped, executed to brief, and measured against both brand and performance objectives - preventing value leakage in complex, multi-stakeholder arrangements. Global & Multi-Market Scope Develop and maintain a global view of the partnership landscape, identifying where deals at .com level or spanning multiple regulated markets can deliver efficiencies and scale. Work with country managers and regional teams to understand local market needs, regulatory constraints, and audience nuances - ensuring partnerships are fit-for-purpose across every market they operate in. Balance global ambition with local relevance, ensuring partnership strategy serves both brand-building at scale and acquisition in specific regulated markets. Team Leadership & Development Lead and grow a team responsible for the day-to-day management of digital media partnerships, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback and actively supporting career development. Build a high-performing, commercially minded team capable of managing a complex, multi-market partnership portfolio across brand and performance objectives. Contribute to hiring decisions as the team scales, and develop a team structure that reflects the breadth and ambition of the partnerships function. Brand Positioning & Cross-Channel Collaboration Serve as the Paid Media team's primary executor of Easygo's brand positioning strategy through paid partnerships, ensuring all partner environments, placements, and integrations reflect brand standards and reinforce strategic positioning. Collaborate with channel leads across Paid Search, Paid Social and Programmatic to ensure a cohesive, non-duplicative messaging strategy across all paid touchpoints. Contribute to integrated planning cycles - providing partnership forecasts, inventory insights, and activation plans to inform broader media and marketing strategy. Performance Measurement & Reporting Define and govern KPI frameworks for partnership activity across brand, awareness, and performance dimensions, ensuring measurement infrastructure is agreed and in place before deals go live. Oversee partnership performance reporting, delivering clear insights and recommendations to the Head of Paid Media and relevant stakeholders on a regular cadence. Apply performance learnings to continuously refine the partner assessment framework and guide future investment decisions. Compliance & Brand Safety Ensure all partnerships, placements and integrations meet the relevant brands' safety standards and the regulatory requirements of every market in which they operate. Work with Legal and Compliance teams to review partnership agreements, ensuring all activity is permissible, appropriately disclosed and aligned with market-specific advertising regulations. Factor regulatory constraints into partnership scoping and deal design from the outset - not as a post-deal check, but as a core part of how opportunities are evaluated and structured. Your track record: 6+ years of experience in digital media, with a strong track record in media partnerships, publisher development, or direct media sales/buying. Proven ability to identify, negotiate, and manage complex digital media partnerships, ideally in a multi-market or global context. Strong commercial acumen, experienced in contract negotiation, deal structuring, and budget management. Solid understanding of the digital media landscape, including direct publisher deals, inventory types, SSPs, PMPs, and how programmatic and direct channels complement each other. items.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Digital Native Business - Munich
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you’ll drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with top enterprises, unlocking new value streams throughout their business. You’ll leverage your consultative sales expertise to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to customers, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities. In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you’ll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the landscape. The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI. Responsibilities: Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic. Find your way to the right people at prospective customers, educate them about LLMs, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to launch Design and execute innovative sales strategies to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities, partnerships, and campaigns Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and use cases. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings and sustain a competitive edge Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering customer feedback and conveying market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition and enhance the customer experience Continuously refine the sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency You may be a good fit if you have: 5+ years of enterprise sales experience driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach A track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals by understanding multifaceted technical requirements and crafting tailored solutions Demonstrated ability to navigate dynamic stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently and build connections across all customer levels, from ICs to C-level executives A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves'' mentality. You are a true team player A strategic, analytical approach to assessing markets combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €205.000 — €255.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

As part of our rapid global expansion we are looking for a Partner Sales Manager for our Cloudera partnership in the US to join our growing North America Partner GTM team. Our ambitions are high and wide, and to bring to market the most advanced AI technology, we are building a best-in-class Go-To-Market team. Builders wanted! items.title: Research & Education Sales Lead, Beneficial Deployments
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team accelerates the work of organizations doing some of the world's most important under-resourced work: nonprofits, education institutions, scientific researchers, and organizations advancing economic mobility. Research institutions sit at the center of that mission. They produce the science the rest of the world builds on, and they are structurally short on time, budget, and technical capacity to figure out new technology on their own. You will lead our targeted approach to research institutes and research intensive universities globally. Where our scaled motion reaches thousands of organizations one to many, this role is the opposite end of the same ecosystem: a deliberately short list of institutions where depth matters, where a lab, a department, or a whole campus adopting Claude changes what science gets done, and where the buying process runs through provosts, research offices, procurement, grant budgets, and security review. Reach comes first, and commercial results follow from it. That ordering is deliberate and it is shared across every leader on this team: a research institute that adopts Claude to move its science faster is a win on its own terms, and you will be measured on creating that value with the institutions that matter most, not only on pipeline. You are the single accountable owner for the research Enterprise book globally: its target list, its AEs, its numbers, and its field voice inside Anthropic. You are half seller, half domain translator. You will personally run the most complex institutional deals, and you will be credible in a room of scientists and research leaders. You know how research is funded, how a university decides, and what it takes for a research sales motion to land in a software company. You will bring that knowledge to the product, applied AI, and marketing teams who build for this audience. This is a player coach seat. You will be directly involved in deals and directing the account executives who cover research institutes and universities today, and the role is expected to grow thoughtfully with more AEs in key regions globally. Key responsibilities Co-design our global research strategy: the target list of research institutes and research intensive universities that advance scientific discovery. Serve as the lead on our most complex institutional deals — setting the pursuit strategy, opening doors with lab and research-office leadership, university provosts, and personally resolving the toughest hurdles: procurement, security review, and grant-funded budgets. Direct and coach the account executives working research accounts today: joint account plans, deal reviews, and a repeatable motion for landing a university and expanding within it. Build the institutional playbook: how an institute goes from a pilot to a working deployment across a department, what good adoption looks like, and when to bring in applied AI, customer success, or partners. Own the book's numbers, institutions reached, activated, and expanded against goals, and use them to decide where the effort goes next. Work in lockstep with our PLG 1:many motion, so that an institution moves cleanly between scaled programs and direct coverage in both directions. Minimum qualifications Research sales. You have sold software as a service into universities, research institutes, or academic medical centers, and you have personally closed complex institutional agreements involving procurement, security review, and multiple decision makers. Science background. You have trained or worked in a scientific field, or spent a meaningful part of your career selling to or building for scientists, and you can hold a credible conversation with a principal investigator about their research. Sales leadership. You have led a sales business end to end and been the accountable owner for its results, whether as a team lead, a player coach, or the sole owner of a strategic book. Preferred qualifications Global research landscape: experience selling to universities or research institutes in more than one region, an understanding of how funding and procurement differ from country to country, and comfort working across time zones with regional teams. Experience with research funding: grants, indirect costs, and how a fixed annual budget shapes what an institution can buy. items.title: Sales Onboarding Manager
items.description: Perplexity is hiring sellers fast, and every new seller has to learn a fast-moving product line: Enterprise, Comet, Computer and the API. We're looking for a Sales Onboarding Manager to own how new sellers go from their first day to selling on their own. You'll build the program, keep it current, run it, and certify that each seller is ready before they sell independently. This is a high-ownership, highly visible role on a small Sales Enablement team. You'll partner with the Sales Enablement Lead and work closely with sales leaders, frontline managers, Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and Revenue Operations. Your goal is a robust, relevant, progressive and measurable ramp that gets faster as we scale. ABOUT THE ROLE The Sales Onboarding Manager owns the onboarding experience for Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives (AEs) and Business Development Representatives (BDRs), from Day 1 through field certification. You'll design the curriculum, keep it up to date as the product changes, lead the sessions yourself, manage the logistics of placing each cohort into the right sessions, and run the certifications that decide when a new hire is ready. Company-wide new-hire orientation is owned by a separate onboarding role. Ongoing training for ramped sellers is owned by Sales Enablement. You'll partner with both so new sellers move smoothly from orientation into their sales ramp and then into working independently with ongoing training from Enablement. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own the sales onboarding program. Co-design and run role-based ramps for BDRs and for Enterprise and Commercial AEs, including learning objectives, milestones and time-to-productivity targets for each stage. Where BDRs and AEs need the same foundations, they learn them together. Where the jobs differ, each gets its own track. - Build the BDR ramp. Teach new BDRs prospecting and outbound: ideal customer profile and persona research, account and territory rules, multi-channel sequences, cold calling, cold email, qualification, and clean handoffs to AEs. Get BDRs productive in the prospecting stack, including Salesforce, Apollo and the dialer. - Build and maintain content. Create and update modules, playbooks, talk tracks, demo guides, knowledge checks and self-paced content. Update materials as products, pricing, positioning and process change, and retire anything out of date. - Facilitate live sessions. Lead engaging, interactive sessions (virtual and in person) on Perplexity's products, sales process, customer personas, discovery, demos, objection handling and tools. Bring in subject-matter experts from Product, Product Marketing, Solutions and top sellers. - Run cohort logistics. Work with Recruiting and sales leaders to track incoming hires, assign each one to the right sessions for their role, segment and start date, and manage calendars, attendance, make-ups and pre-work. - Certify field readiness. Design and run role-specific certifications using clear rubrics. For BDRs, that means cold-call, email and qualification certifications. For AEs, it means pitch, discovery and demo certifications. Both roles also certify on tools. Calibrate scoring with BDR and sales managers, give actionable feedback, and decide when a new hire is ready to sell on their own. - Partner with frontline managers. Give managers visibility into each new hire's progress, flag risks early, and equip managers to reinforce onboarding through coaching and call reviews. - Measure and improve. Track completion, certification pass rates and ramp attainment. For BDRs, also track activity, meetings booked and accepted, and pipeline sourced. For AEs, also track time to first meeting, pipeline and closed business. Use the data and new-hire feedback to improve the program each cohort. - Scale with leverage. Use AI tools, including Perplexity's own products, to build content faster, personalize learning paths and automate repetitive logistics so the program keeps up with hiring. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR The best candidates are strong facilitators who also design programs and run operations well. You can command a room, build a curriculum from a blank page, and keep a complicated cohort calendar running smoothly. You hold a high bar for readiness and know how to tell a manager when a seller isn't there yet. Must-haves - 2–4 years in sales enablement, sales onboarding or sales training, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or AI company. Experience carrying a quota or managing sellers is a strong plus. - A track record of designing and running a sales onboarding or ramp program end to end, with measurable impact on ramp time or productivity. - Excellent live facilitation, virtual and in person, with sellers at different experience levels, from early-career BDRs to seasoned AEs. - Experience designing and running certifications or skills assessments (such as cold-call, pitch, discovery or demo) using rubrics that sales managers trust. - Strong program management and operational rigor. You can run several overlapping cohorts, schedules and stakeholders without dropping details. - Working knowledge of modern sales methods (such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message or similar), outbound prospecting and the full sales cycle from first touch to close. - Comfort learning technical products quickly and explaining them clearly. You can learn an AI product well enough to teach and demo it. - Fluency with the sales tech stack, such as Salesforce, a conversation-intelligence tool and an LMS or content-management platform. - High ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment where the product changes weekly. Nice to have - Experience onboarding sellers for AI, developer or other technically complex products. - Background in instructional design or adult learning. - Previous experience as a BDR/SDR or as a BDR/SDR manager. - Experience building onboarding for both Enterprise and Commercial/velocity sales motions, or for Customer Success roles. - Experience standing up enablement tooling (LMS, content hub, call library) or reporting on ramp metrics. - Experience using AI to build content or automate enablement operations

items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customization to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. items.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors (RIAs). Our integration ecosystem spans core technology partners, specialized workflow and TAMP partners, and a broader network of consultants, recruiters, and capital providers. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, Business Development, and the tactical integrations team. It's a collaborative group focused on advisor success and on building partnerships that last! The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations owns TradePMR's external-facing relationships with technology partners and advisor firms across the integration ecosystem. The tactical integrations team handles vendor onboarding, data feeds, and technical implementation. You'll decide which partnerships matter most and who we should build them with. You'll advise enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams, host partner events, negotiate special agreements, and equip our sales teams with accurate partner collateral. You'll also bring partner and client insight into integration roadmap discussions, shaping priorities through influence and input rather than build ownership. This is a business and partnerships role, not a product or engineering role, and your impact will show up in the strength of our advisor and partner relationships! This role is based in our Tampa, FL and Clearwater, FLoffice(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Serve as a direct advisor to enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams evaluating custody transitions and platform fit Own and run Transition Sandbox walkthroughs, live demo environments for prospective and transitioning firms Act as a trusted point of contact for advisor firms navigating the TradePMR integration ecosystem Build and maintain the Partner Resource Hub, including custodial comparison sheets, integration guides, and platform one-pagers Equip Practice Management and Sales with current, accurate partner and integration collateral, and keep internal teams informed of live and upcoming integrations Own and execute the Center of Influence (COI) engagement cadence, including monthly strategy touchpoints, quarterly briefings, and virtual executive roundtables Stand up and run the COI Advisory Council, spanning consulting, technology, M&A, and recruiting Directly own relationships with core technology partners and specialized workflow and TAMP partners Coordinate with Marketing and Business Development on adjacent COI relationships, such as transition consultants, M&A advisors, capital providers, breakaway recruiters, and compliance consultants Plan and represent TradePMR at flagship partner events, and own regional VIP dinners and executive roundtables, including guest lists, briefing content, and follow-up Negotiate custom commercial terms with strategic partners, such as portfolio-wide custodial fee schedules, custom API reporting SLAs, and enterprise onboarding SLAs Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on sign-off for non-standard agreements, using a template-first approach and escalating to custom terms only where justified Surface partner and client integration requests and pain points into Product and Engineering prioritization discussions Represent the external partner and advisor-firm perspective in integration roadmap planning, and work with the tactical integrations team so strategic priorities turn into executed integrations What you bring 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic account management, ideally in wealthtech, fintech, or RIA custodial and technology services Demonstrated experience managing external relationships with technology vendors and/or advisor or client firms in a regulated financial services environment Comfort serving as a primary external face for the organization, including event hosting, executive-level relationship management, and negotiation Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, and technical integrations teams Familiarity with the RIA custodial technology landscape (portfolio management systems, CRM, TAMP, and financial planning tools) is a plus What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $179,000 — $210,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $157,000 — $185,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $139,000 — $164,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.title: Middle Live Account Manager
items.description: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people . With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a skilled and highly driven Middle Live Account Manager on Malta! About the job: EM Live is seeking a commercially minded Account Manager to build strong customer relationships and help partners maximise the value of our live casino offering. This is a mid-level role for someone who understands the live gaming provider landscape, takes ownership, and is motivated to grow accounts through insight, responsiveness, and consistent execution. The successful candidate will combine at least three years of relevant industry experience with a hungry, proactive mindset. They will be confident working with customers and internal teams, curious about the product and market, and willing to keep learning as EM Live grows. Key Responsibilities: Own and develop a portfolio of EM Live customers, acting as their primary commercial contact. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and maintain a clear understanding of their objectives, priorities, and challenges. Create and execute account plans that support retention, revenue growth, product adoption, and long-term partnership value. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across EM Live products, tables, markets, and promotional initiatives. Monitor account performance, player and market trends, and key commercial indicators; turn insights into clear customer recommendations. Lead regular business reviews and provide accurate updates on performance, opportunities, risks, and agreed actions. Coordinate effectively with commercial, product, operations, marketing, and technical teams to deliver for customers. Work with customers to optimise EM Live site positioning, visibility, and placement across casino lobbies and relevant promotional areas. Plan, coordinate, and evaluate customer promotions that drive awareness, engagement, and commercial performance. Support launches, integrations, and new-market activity, ensuring stakeholders remain informed and aligned. Maintain accurate account records, commercial forecasts, opportunities, and next steps in the relevant systems. Stay informed about the live casino market, competitor activity, and emerging customer needs. Requirements: At least three years of account management, commercial, or partner-facing experience with a live gaming provider. Practical understanding of live casino products, operator needs, commercial models, and the wider online gaming ecosystem. Demonstrated ability to manage customer relationships, prioritise competing demands, and follow through on commitments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to lead customer meetings and business reviews. Commercial awareness and comfort using performance data to identify opportunities and recommend actions. Collaborative working style and the ability to influence internal stakeholders without direct authority. Strong organisation, attention to detail, and a disciplined approach to forecasting and account planning. Demonstrated experience and practical knowledge of site positioning, including optimising live casino visibility and placement within operator lobbies. Hands-on experience planning, running, and reviewing customer promotions that support engagement and revenue growth. Desirable : Experience supporting live casino launches, integrations, dedicated tables, or branded environments. Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or customer segments. Turkish language skills are preferred. What Success Looks Like : Hungry: actively looks for opportunities, asks the right questions, and is not satisfied with simply maintaining the status quo. Motivated: takes ownership of outcomes, follows through, and brings energy and resilience to customer challenges. Willing to learn: seeks feedback, builds product and market knowledge quickly, and adapts as the business evolves. Customer-focused: listens carefully, communicates clearly, and balances customer needs with sustainable commercial outcomes. Collaborative: works constructively across teams and shares information early to keep delivery on track. Here's what we offer: Start with a competitive number of annual leave days, increasing as you grow with us. Private Medical Subscription. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Access to online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Gym membership. Meal allowance. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Business Development Lead - US
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? This role decides where KICK’s next revenue comes from. As our Business Development Lead in the US, you’ll win new agency groups, verticals and enterprise clients, and shape the offers that win them. What you’ll build with us: We are looking for a Business Development Lead to grow KICK's advertising business in the US. You will find and win clients that are new to KICK, make the case for advertising on the platform, and close the first deals that become long-term partnerships. This is a full-time opportunity based in New York. You’ll work from home, but you won’t be working alone. You’ll be out in the market with agencies and advertisers, working closely with our US commercial team and connected to our Australian and Serbian teams as we build KICK’s US presence together. Who is Easygo and KICK? Easygo is a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands, including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. These brands have a fierce global following, but our crew is employed directly by Easygo, and that’s where the real fun happens. KICK is our live streaming platform, built to put creators and their communities first. It gives content creators 95% of their streaming income and has redefined what a live streaming platform can be. KICK started as a disruptor challenging the status quo. Since launching in 2022, it has grown to more than 100 million accounts, and 81.7% of its audience is aged 18 to 34. Creators stream on KICK across gaming, talk shows, podcasts, IRL, sport and events. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast, and who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact, and that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. items.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest-velocity, highest-volume post-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast-moving book of accounts. This is a revenue-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first - more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook. You will: - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high-volume book of business. - Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate - building a team culture where expansions and cross-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota-carrying sales function. - Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful. - Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount. - Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI-powered approaches to their work. - Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership. - Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high-volume, transactional or corporate-segment books of business. - Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct. - 2+ years of direct people leadership experience - managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high-performance, feedback-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact. - Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed. - Strong player-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios. - Expertise in post-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high-volume, scaled motion. - Strategic operational thinking: able to make sound calls on segmentation, playbook design, and process at scale as account volume grows. - Strong analytical and operational skills: adept at using data to identify performance trends, optimize workflows, and forecast outcomes across a large book. - Bonus: Hands-on with tools (ElevenLabs, Salesforce, Gong, Lemlist, Sigma) and capable of improving data quality, visibility, and usage insights across the team. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the U.S., with the ability to operate between GMT-4 and GMT-7 timezones required. We'd love for you to be based in New York or San Francisco where you can work out of our office, but it's not a requirement. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Deep fluency in banking and insurance regulation (model risk, third-party risk, data protection, consumer protection), which you can speak to without a briefing - Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex, multi-stakeholder cycles - Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once - Executive presence at C-suite and board levels - Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview As our VP of Sales - Global Public Sector, you will spearhead year-over-year global revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level PUBSEC customer acquisition strategies. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in the public sector. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. Key Responsibilities As our VP of Public Sector Sales you will: - Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive, global go-to-market growth strategy and sales plan for the Public Sector, driving revenue growth and market expansion working with other regional sales teams. - Provide sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s PUBSEC sales team, ensuring alignment with company objectives and priorities. - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals. - Represent Cohere at PUBSEC industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with other regional and global leaders in Cohere. - Manage and nurture relationships with government decision-makers and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals. - Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles. Qualifications This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you: - Have 10+ years of PUBSEC sales and leadership experience leading go-to-market efforts and driving revenue growth for fast paced technology organizations. - Have an established network, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations with an emphasis on the Defense and Intelligence communities. - Possess a proven track record of leading capture and sales efforts for consultative solution sales and business development efforts, with a deep understanding of regional procurement and budget cycles, customer success, and resource allocation. - Have exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships and influence at all levels. - Are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, coordinating efforts across cross-functional teams and regions without the need for a large direct organization. - Are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of working independently, rolling up sleeves, and driving impact as a ‘builder.’ - Experience in AI or a related industry is highly desirable. - Must be willing to travel (25-40%). WORKING LOCATION: This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer to take full ownership of paid acquisition for an international business operating in the adult creator economy. This is a hands-on position for a performance marketing specialist who knows how to scale campaigns in restricted verticals, manage substantial advertising budgets, and optimize traffic based on actual customer revenue. Responsibilities - Take ownership of paid traffic acquisition, with Meta as the primary advertising platform, while developing additional acquisition channels through Google Ads, native advertising, and adult ad networks - Plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns targeting the US, UK, and Australian markets, managing budgets and optimizing performance across the entire customer journey - Develop and improve acquisition funnels connecting advertising campaigns, landing and bridge pages, private chat interactions, and paid conversions, including subscriptions, PPV purchases, and custom content - Focus campaign optimization on commercial performance, tracking cost per chat, cost per first purchase, customer payback periods, and 30-day customer value rather than relying solely on CTR, CPM, or other top-of-funnel metrics - Establish a structured creative testing and scaling process, evaluating different concepts, defining performance thresholds, allocating test budgets, and identifying opportunities for profitable growth - Maintain stable advertising operations in restricted verticals through compliant account structures, careful budget scaling, proactive account management, and appropriate recovery procedures following restrictions or suspensions - Build and manage the tracking and attribution infrastructure, including tools such as Keitaro, server-side conversion events, and postbacks, ensuring reliable reporting and accurate campaign optimization - Collaborate with creative and customer engagement teams to improve messaging, landing pages, conversion quality, and monetization throughout the funnel - Monitor advertising profitability, investigate performance discrepancies, and continuously refine acquisition strategies based on revenue and customer behavior - Work directly with the founder on acquisition priorities, performance reviews, and growth opportunities, with the potential to mentor and lead junior media buyers as the function expands Requirements - 4+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or media buying, including substantial exposure to such advertising verticals as adult, dating, nutra, or gambling - Proven track record of personally managing monthly advertising budgets of $100,000 or more on Meta within adult, dating, nutra, or gambling verticals, including successfully scaling at least one offer from initial testing to this spending level - Advanced expertise in Meta Ads, covering campaign structure, creative testing, budget allocation, optimization, and scaling strategies - Practical experience with Google Ads and at least one native or adult advertising network, with an understanding of how acquisition approaches differ between traffic sources - Strong knowledge of performance marketing economics, including acquisition costs, first-purchase conversion, payback periods, customer value, and revenue-based campaign evaluation - Experience maintaining advertising account stability in policy-sensitive industries, including account preparation, gradual scaling, appeals, and legitimate recovery from suspensions - Ability to design and execute systematic creative testing strategies, make data-backed scaling decisions, and discontinue underperforming campaigns efficiently - Hands-on experience configuring tracking platforms such as Keitaro, Voluum, RedTrack, or similar, including server-side conversion tracking, postbacks, and attribution troubleshooting - Strong analytical skills, commercial judgment, and the ability to independently manage substantial budgets and campaign performance - Ability to demonstrate previous campaign results and personally managed advertising accounts or dashboards during the assessment process, with sensitive information anonymized where necessary - Upper-intermediate or higher level of English for business communication and daily work What's in it for you - Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from any time zone - Competitive senior-level base salary - Direct collaboration with the founder and significant influence over paid acquisition strategy and commercial results - Opportunity to build and develop the media buying function, with potential to take on team leadership responsibilities as the business grows - A dynamic environment with opportunities for professional development and long-term growth
